Local builds on MacOS 27.0.1 not working for me. The dylib builds OK but it fails to build the tarball.
I have updated to sd3.5.1 but still no better.
There are warnings like this

**/Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer/Platforms/MacOSX.platform/Developer/SDKs/MacOSX27.0.sdk/usr/include/c++/v1/__configuration/availability.h:204:4:** **warning:**

  204 | #  warning "The selected platform is no longer supported by libc++."

then after the dylib has been built, I see 

Built target tarball-install

Any ideas, please?
Tony ... Are you working with the master branch or ?.

Correction... it is building the tarball but there are worrysome errors.
I have pushed to my Master. Cicleci fails to run

Config version 2 has reached end of life. Please upgrade to version 2.1. https://discuss.circleci.com/t/breaking-changes-config-compilation-updates-july-17-2026/54719

Suspect update-templates sd3.5.1 is not being used.
In the cmake folder TemplateVersion reads: tags: sd3.4.6. Might be worth updating again.

Config version 2 has reached end of life.

Was fixed in sd3.5.1.

Whoops.... I had rolled back and confused github. Now seems to be working.
